plugins.name: inline-presentation
plugins.description: Detects when an assistant response contains structured or relational data (process, relational, hierarchical, time-series, comparative, key-value, numeric/proportion, set/categorical) and renders it inline using a fixed catalog of CLI-friendly forms (ASCII flowcharts, tree views, ER-style diagrams, Gantt bars, side-by-side cards, two-column tables, horizontal bars, cluster cards). Operates by default â anticipates the right visual form so the user does not have to ask 'can you make this visual?'. No Mermaid, no LaTeX, no color conventions â purely structural.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: kanban-management
plugins.description: Transform user stories (from user-story-generator) and user journeys (from user-journey-management) into a central kanban.md file at the project root. Analyzes dependencies and proposes a numerical priority ordering when missing. The kanban.md is the single source of truth for development status with TODO / DOING / DONE sections, manually editable by moving stories between sections. On a re-run the skill iteratively reconciles changes (new / removed / status conflicts / dependency changes) with the user. On request, renders three projections from the data via inline-presentation - progress percentage (P-7 bar), kanban board (P-8 cluster cards), and dependency flowchart (P-1 ASCII). Stops on circular dependencies and asks the user to fix the source. All stories start in TODO on first run.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: company-research
plugins.description: Autonomous web research that produces a sales/outreach-ready HTML company brief. Identifies people via website, news, blogs, conference talks, podcasts, GitHub, Scholar/arXiv, patents, SEC filings, Crunchbase, and trade press. Public sources only, every claim cited with source URL. Output is a single self-contained HTML file with a function-grouped person-card grid (Leadership / GTM / Engineering / Product / Other), recent-activity timeline, and grounded outreach hooks. No private contact data, no login-gated platforms.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: person-research
plugins.description: Autonomous digital footprint audit for a named person. Surfaces every publicly findable item across self-published channels (own socials, blogs, code, video, audio), third-party publications (news, interviews, conference talks, papers, patents, court/KvK filings, Wikipedia, mentions, image search, Wayback Machine), and leaked-but-public sources (breach databases, pastebins â meta only, no payload). Output is a single self-contained HTML brief with origin badges (self/third/leaked) and removal difficulty per item, plus a prioritized takedown action list so the subject can request removal. Public sources only. Refuses dossiers on minors without consent or adversarial research requests.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: write-frontend-documentation
plugins.description: Research a frontend codebase end-to-end, propose an approval-gated documentation plan, then generate developer- and LLM-agent-oriented documentation in a consistent house style. Auto-detects framework, routing, state, styling, API, build/deploy, and tests with path:line evidence. Adapts the structure to the techniques actually found. A single README lives in the frontend root; generated docs use UPPERCASE filenames under documentation/. Existing docs are archived under documentation/archive, never blindly overwritten. Nothing is written before the user approves the plan.

A single README lives in the backend root linking into a documentation/ tree; generated docs use UPPERCASE filenames. Existing docs are archived under documentation/archive, never blindly overwritten. Nothing is written before the user approves the plan.

plugins.description: Plan + execute discipline with explicit checkpoints.
